why: FKT lollipop from Green Lakes Trailhead via a climber's trail onto the northwest ridge matches the NW Ridge standard route in the opened source.
FKT is an up-and-back from Kahiltna base camp, with split times to Camp 1 at 7800, i.e. the West Buttress line, which the opened guide profile describes from the glacier landing.
FKT SW Buttress car-to-car track starts at Elkhart Park (43.0045,-109.7515) and the opened trip report climbs the same Indian Basin / southwest buttress-ridge to the summit.
FKT standard route is the Cables Route up and down from the valley floor via the Mist Trail, matching the NPS description of the Half Dome trail with cables.
FKT names the South Side Route from Timberline Lodge via Hogsback and Pearly Gates/Old Chute, and Mountain Project's South Side Route describes the same line from the same trailhead.

FKT climbs the Royal Arches route car-to-car from the Ahwahnee lot and descends the North Dome gully, matching Mountain Project's Royal Arches (5.7 A0), which names the Ahwahnee approach and the North Dome Gully walk-off.
The FKT line climbs the Nose from the base of El Capitan and walks back down; our route is the Nose on the southwest face.
The FKT line is the standard west-side route from the Slesse Creek road, which our Southwest Gully route describes: steep climbers trail to treeline, then the gully on the summit tower west side.
